en-US.title: Go Flashcards
en-US.subtitle: Tsumego & joseki trainer
en-US.promoText: Practice Go life-and-death and joseki from your own SGF files, with spaced repetition and guided learning.
en-US.description:
Go Flashcards turns SGF files into a training routine for Go (baduk / weiqi).

Bring your own problems: import .sgf, .sgf.gz or .zip files, including whole collections of puzzles, or paste SGF text. Every puzzle is checked before it is added, and common older formats and text encodings are handled for you. A few starter puzzles are included.

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Guided: see the correct moves as you play.
• Unguided: find the moves yourself. Your accuracy and speed set a skill level for each puzzle, from red to gold.
• Free exploration: play any move and see where the book line goes.
• Multiple choice puzzles, and an optional step where you mark every good move before you play one.

SPACED REPETITION
Add puzzles to spaced repetition and they come due again at the right time, based on how well you know them.

GUIDED LEARNING
Add a puzzle to guided learning and the app gives you some of the moves to click through, fewer each time you get it right. Once you can solve it alone, a timed run asks you to solve every line of the puzzle, in random order, as fast as you can. Your score is correct moves per minute, halved for every mistake. Two attempts per puzzle per day keeps practice focused.

BUILD YOUR OWN PUZZLES
The built-in editor lets you set up a position on any board from 2x2 to 25x25, including rectangular boards and diagrams with open edges, then enter the move tree and mark each branch right or wrong.

DESIGNED FOR PRACTICE
• Optional color flipping so you learn the shape, not the colors.
• Tap-to-zoom for placing stones on large boards.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your puzzles and progress stay on your device.

review.notes:
No account or login is needed; the app has no network features.

To review: the library opens with four starter puzzles. Tap a puzzle to expand it, then try Guided, Unguided or Explore. Tapping "Add to guided learning" shows the guided-learning panel. "+ SGF" opens the import screen, where you can paste this SGF text to add a puzzle:

(;GM[1]FF[4]SZ[19]GN[Review test]PL[B]AB[aa][bb]AW[ab];B[ac]TE[1])

Puzzle files are chosen by the user from their own device; the app does not download any content.
